description: List recent posts. Filter by status or account. Every post carries `error_message` and `retry_count`: on a failed post the platform's own refusal and how many attempts it took before Chirpie gave up, and on a deleted one the reason Chirpie cancelled it (`account_disconnected`, `account_deactivated`, or `connection_lost` when the platform stopped accepting the account's credential). `platform_post_url` is the public permalink once published. A post the user deleted stays in the listing with status 'deleted' and no cancel reason: Chirpie never removes a post's history. Posts the user hid with chirpie_hide_post are left out unless include_hidden is true, and `hidden` on each post says which those are.

group_id.description: Only the posts of one fan-out, from the group_id a multi-account chirpie_post or chirpie_thread returned. Every post also carries its own group_id, or null when it went to a single account.

include_hidden.description: Include posts the user hid with chirpie_hide_post. Off by default on every filter, because hiding is the user saying they do not want to see it.

status.description: Filter: draft, scheduled, publishing, published, failed, deleted. With no filter the listing is what has been sent, queued or tried, so drafts are left out; ask for them with status 'draft'.

name: chirpie_list_posts
title: List posts
